# Game Idea: Asteroid Dodge

- **Genre:** Endless arcade / avoidance
- **Mechanic:** Control a ship that moves horizontally across the canvas. Asteroids spawn at the top and fall with increasing speed.
- **Goal:** Dodge as many asteroids as possible to rack up a high score.
- **Lose condition:** The game ends instantly when the ship collides with any asteroid.
- **Canvas use:** Simple shape drawing, sprite animation, and collision detection via `requestAnimationFrame`.

1: // Game: Asteroid Dodge – simple endless arcade
2: // Assumes an HTML canvas element with id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Audio setup using Web Audio API
9:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
10:   const playTone = (freq, type = 'sine', duration = 0.2) => {
11:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
13:     osc.type = type;
14:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
15:     osc.connect(gain);
16:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
17:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
18:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
19:     osc.start();
20:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
21:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
22:   };
23: 
24:   // Adjust canvas size to fill its container or use defaults
25:   const resize = () => {
26:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
27:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
28:   };
29:   resize();
30:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
31: 
32:   // Create starfield background
33:   const stars = [];
34:   const STAR_COUNT = 100;
35:   const initStars = () => {
36:     for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
37:       stars.push({
38:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
39:         y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
40:         radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5
41:       });
42:     }
43:   };
44:   initStars();
45: 
46:   // Ship definition – simple triangle with gradient fill
47:   const ship = {
48:   const ship = {
49:     width: 40,
50:     height: 20,
51:     x: 0,
52:     y: 0,
53:     speed: 5,
54:     init() {
55:       this.x = canvas.width / 2 - this.width / 2;
56:       this.y = canvas.height - this.height - 10;
57:     },
58:     draw() {
59:     // Gradient fill for ship
60:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
61:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#00ffff');
62:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#0066ff');
63:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
64:     ctx.beginPath();
65:     ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y + this.height);
66:     ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width / 2, this.y);
67:     ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width, this.y + this.height);
68:     ctx.closePath();
69:     ctx.fill();
70:     }
71:   };
72:   ship.init();
73: 
74:   // Input handling – left/right arrows / A D keys
75:   const keys = {};
76:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
77:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
78: 
79:   // Asteroid pool
80:   const asteroids = [];
81:   const asteroidProto = {
82:     radius: 15,
83:     x: 0,
84:     y: 0,
85:     speed: 2,
86:     reset() {
87:       this.radius = 10 + Math.random() * 15;
88:       this.x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - this.radius * 2) + this.radius;
89:       this.y = -this.radius;
90:       this.speed = 2 + Math.random() * 3 + score / 100; // accelerate with score
91:       // subtle ping when an asteroid re‑appears
92:       playTone(300, 'triangle', 0.05);
93:     },
94:     update() {
95:       this.y += this.speed;
96:       if (this.y - this.radius > canvas.height) this.reset();
97:     },
98:     draw() {
99:       // Radial gradient for a 3D rock look
100:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
101:         this.x,
102:         this.y,
103:         this.radius * 0.2,
104:         this.x,
105:         this.y,
106:         this.radius
107:       );
108:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbbbbb');
109:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555555');
110:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
111:       ctx.beginPath();
112:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
113:       ctx.fill();
114:     }
115:   };
116: 
117:   // Spawn initial asteroids
118:   for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
119:     const a = Object.create(asteroidProto);
120:     a.reset();
121:     // stagger start positions
122:     a.y = -Math.random() * canvas.height;
123:     asteroids.push(a);
124:   }
125: 
126:   let score = 0;
127:   let gameOver = false;
128: 
129:   const update = () => {
130:     if (gameOver) return;
131:     // move ship
132:     if (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) ship.x -= ship.speed;
133:     if (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) ship.x += ship.speed;
134:     // keep within bounds
135:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.width, ship.x));
136: 
137:     // update asteroids
138:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.update());
139:     // Move stars for a subtle parallax effect
140:     const STAR_SPEED = 0.3;
141:     stars.forEach(star => {
142:       star.y += STAR_SPEED;
143:       if (star.y > canvas.height) {
144:         star.y = 0;
145:         star.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
146:       }
147:     });
148: 
149:     // collision detection (simple AABB vs circle)
150:     for (const a of asteroids) {
151:       const cx = ship.x + ship.width / 2;
152:       const cy = ship.y + ship.height / 2;
153:       const distX = Math.abs(a.x - cx);
154:       const distY = Math.abs(a.y - cy);
155:       if (distX > (ship.width / 2 + a.radius) || distY > (ship.height / 2 + a.radius)) continue;
156:       if (distX <= ship.width / 2 || distY <= ship.height / 2) { gameOver = true; break; }
157:       const dx = distX - ship.width / 2;
158:       const dy = distY - ship.height / 2;
159:       if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= a.radius * a.radius) { gameOver = true; break; }
160:     }
161: 
162:     if (!gameOver) score++;
163:   };
164: 
165:   const draw = () => {
166:     // Background gradient (deep space)
167:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
168:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0d0d25');
169:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000020');
170:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
171:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
172: 
173:     // Draw stars
174:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
175:     stars.forEach(star => {
176:       ctx.beginPath();
177:       ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
178:       ctx.fill();
179:     });
180: 
181:     ship.draw();
182:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.draw());
183:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
184:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
185:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
186:     if (gameOver) {
187:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
188:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
189:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
190:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
191:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
192:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
193:     }
194:   };
195: 
196:   const loop = () => {
197:     update();
198:     draw();
199:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
200:   };
201:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
202: })();

(End of file - total 202 lines)
</content>
